feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 August 2026 11:19am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 02 August 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind warning for overnight.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near Greenland, with low pressure southwest of Ireland, tracking northeast.


##Wind##

Mainly east or southeast 2 to 4, backing east or northeast later this afternoon, becoming mainly northeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5, later in the evening, then increasing 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the north for a time overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Mostly fair, with just patchy rain spreading from the west later this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in places later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4, veering south or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, becoming more widespread for a time later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
